takes.h: Steve Miner returns to direct a new Jason film, set for 2027
takes.p: Steve Miner, who directed Friday the 13th Part 2 (1981) and Part III (1982), will direct an untitled Jason Universe film from a screenplay by David Fliegel, Dread Central reports, citing Deadline. Horror, Inc. will finance and produce it with CatchLight Studios. Cast and plot are unannounced.
